prompt: Stage 5-2, level 9 with 28 gold at 36 HP, five players left. You hold an AD component and a defensive component that do not make anything your carry wants; your carry already has three items. Your 5-cost tank has one item. What do you do with the two components?

options.label: Combine them into whatever they make and put it on the 5-cost tank or the 4-cost bruiser now
Hold them for the next carousel to complete a better item
Hold them until you find a second carry to itemise

explanation:
At 5-2 with 36 HP the game has three or four fights left for you, and an item on the bench contributes to none of them. Two components on a frontliner are a completed item's worth of stats in every one of those fights, and the tank with one item is the unit whose survival decides whether your three-item carry gets to cast. 'Not BIS' is a stage-3 concern; at stage 5 an item is either on the board or wasted.

The next carousel is at 5-4, two fights away, and even then you would have to pick a component you need over a completed item. A second carry you have not found yet is a unit that does not exist. Slam now, and if a better holder shows up, the item can be moved for free in the planning phase.
principle: In the endgame every component on the bench is a fight you played without it. Slam.
commonMistake: Holding components for a perfect item on a board that does not have enough fights left to use it.
